request: Allow rpc/3 from SWI-WASM pages on other nodes to public N6.
cause: Deployment/n6_adapter.py browser_boundary accepted a cross-origin /call only with an X-Web-Prolog-Query-Owner capability; browser rpc/3 sends a plain GET, so N6 answered 403 to every origin except its own (N1-N5 accept any origin).

change.behaviour: Public anonymous /call accepts any origin; a supplied capability must be well formed; other routes keep the same-origin boundary; owner-only N6 unchanged.

service.delta: running image with only /app/n6/adapter.py replaced (2feba885... -> 055084ed...); container environment unchanged
service.compose: docker compose -p trinity-n6-host --env-file Deployment/.env.n6 -f Deployment/compose.gprolog-n6-local.yaml -f Deployment/compose.gprolog-n6-host.yaml -f Deployment/compose.gprolog-n6-public.yaml up -d --no-build --pull never --no-deps wp_n6

earlier_attempt.cause: BuildKit does not accept a bare image ID in FROM; stopped before any live change.

rollback: docker tag sha256:b3a411c2b639a9b4544fbbf7eab18bca4e6ee5b7b0147b02c9c8c0e627464225 trinity-n6-host:latest (also tagged trinity-n6-host:base-20261116), then the compose up command above from the repository root.
